Your registration will only be approved on the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance. More information in the [Register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ManausPlazaOpenII2025/register) tab. If you have any problem registering, watch [this video](https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=znioC-4r06ap7Urn&t=410).
